name: Flat roofing
summary: Low-slope roofs priced per membrane square plus drains, parapet, curbs, insulation, tear-off and walk pads.

items.label: TPO 45-mil recover membrane
items.source: 1.4 h and $165 per membrane square x 1.08 for 8% waste (suggestedMembraneKit tpo-45; index.html hoursPerSquare, membranePerSquare, wastePct); 40x30 ft = 12 squares (index.html)

items.label: Parapet flashing
items.source: hoursPerParapetLf 0.12, $18/lf (index.html); the specialist also adds up to 10% membrane waste for parapet; 0 lf default

items.label: Tear-off to deck with dumpster
items.source: 0.9 h and $28 dumpster per square (suggestedScopeKit tear-off; index.html dumpsterPerSquare); default scope is recover, so 0

items.label: Trip, travel, mobilization and fasteners
items.source: trip/setup 3 h + travel 0.8 h; fasteners/plates/adhesive $160 + mobilization $350 + travel and equipment $160 (index.html)
